content.text: Rows and columns of data with sorting, selection, nested rows and drag and drop. Describe the columns up front, then render a TableRow for every item.
Set a `selectionMode` to let editors select rows, `showSelectionControls` adds a checkbox to every row. Mark columns as `sortable` and sort the items in `onSortChange`.

`onLoadMore` is called when the rows are scrolled close to the end, to fetch the next page. While `loading` is set, a spinner shows below the rows, or in place of them while there are none. `useAsyncList` keeps the loaded pages: its `load` function receives the `cursor` the previous page returned, and `loadMore` does nothing once a page returns no cursor. Its `items`, `loading`, `loadMore`, `sortDescriptor` and `sort`, and `selectedKeys` and `setSelectedKeys` plug into the props of the table.
Built on the React Aria grid: the arrow keys move between rows, Space selects a row and Enter runs its action. Sortable column headers announce their sort direction.
